question: Has the PDRE-001A 800VDC-to-50V DC/DC shelf path been application-qualified against a defined electrical requirement set?
system_boundary: PDRE-001A 800VDC sidecar or power-rack output through the source-reported 800V-to-50V DC/DC shelf interface; no facility-level PDRE-001B scope.
decision_affected: Whether an electrical application-qualification result exists that could be submitted to CML for a bounded R4 evaluation; no automatic readiness change follows.
minimum_new_evidence: One independently attributable electrical application-qualification result specifying the bounded interface, requirement set, result, event time, knowledge time, and provenance.
stop_condition: Stop after one qualifying result confirms or refutes satisfaction of the defined electrical requirement set, or after an authorized bounded search is exhausted without finding that evidence class.
limitations: The qualification question is not answered.
No external research, qualification test, L1 execution, or L2 authorization occurred.
Mechanical, thermal, insulation, partial-discharge, reliability, EMC, and safety dimensions remain outside this rescope.
